panel.selection: sha256('xcode:'+index) ascending; deterministic exclusions: second index of 4 near-dup pairs (810,455,680,920) and 2 helper-dependent tasks (64,609)
panel.exposure: zero overlap with prior workspace query text

tests.source: assert lines embedded verbatim in each task prompt (what the model sees)
tests.count: 2922 across 974 tasks; selected-100 detail with extracted tests archived in P3_CODE_TASKS_100_DETAIL.json
tests.execution: sandboxed subprocess (timeout, no network), run generated function + extracted asserts
tests.scorer: task correct iff all extracted asserts pass

nodes.prompt: restate requirement, design signature/algorithm; JSON output

nodes.deployable_failure: runtime error / test failure — deterministic, strongest signal in P3

nodes.input: error message + failing assertions ONLY; NEVER gold (no reference solution even exists in release)

arms.always_medium: mono medium: description -> code, one call, scored by tests
arms.query_router: mono; model = large iff frozen token-length guard else medium
arms.node_type_router: plan(medium)->implement(coder)->execute, one call per node, NO recovery
arms.static_dag: same DAG + deployable failure detection + local fallbacks (plan->large, implement->medium, one retry each) with descendant refresh
arms.dynamic_real: same DAG; deployable detection only (syntax/runtime/test); failed implement -> repair loop (bounded, memory-gated); budget = 1.2 x static realized; selective refresh only

collection.gpu_discipline: engine guard refuses while GPU busy
collection.expected_calls: ~700-1,000 with shared node cache across arms

metrics: task-level pass rate via unit tests

rq.RQ1_stage_complementarity: node-level Oracle vs best fixed model per node type
rq.RQ3_feedback_dynamic: dynamic_real vs static_dag; test-failure-driven repair is the decisive cross-domain witness for deployable-only dynamic adaptation

priority_note: MBPP runs FIRST (user directive): its unit-test feedback is the strongest deployable signal in P3 and directly answers whether Dynamic-Real works in a fully different domain without any gold at runtime.
